notes.title: Patch 1.20 released!
notes.notes:
[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [td]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44373667/96bc521013d8f451a48de65a9fb6456ffe3874c4.png
       [/td]
        [td]Hey everyone, great news! We've just rolled out an update (1.20) for Dinosaurs: Mission Dino Camp that fixes the revive and save/load feature issue.[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

We know how frustrating it was when players got stuck in a fall-off-the-cliff-and-die loop after reviving or loading a game. This update takes care of that problem, so you can enjoy a smoother adventure.

Happy gaming and thanks for your feedback and support! :)

notes.title: New Dinosaurs update!
notes.notes:
[table noborder=1]
    [tr]
        [td]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44373667/96bc521013d8f451a48de65a9fb6456ffe3874c4.png
       [/td]
        [td]Hello everyone, good news for you - an update for the Dinosaurs: Mission Dino Camp is out now addressing some issues and additional improvements. Here is the changelog for v1.10:[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

Controls

Added the option to revert camera Y axis

Gameplay

Fast travel option (allows to skip long travels when you have to return to the lab)
Feeding minigame: visual improvements
Some tutorial improvements and end game instructions

Bugfixes

Fixed quadbike and off-road vehicle behaviour on revive in special cases
Updated dinosaurs movements
Foot IK fix
Other minor issues found

Other

Localization fixes


Enjoy the game with new improvements and changes!
Thanks for your feedback and support! :)
